name: Basilius

facts.text: Basilius is a level-66 named with 30,000 health on Modernagrav; six come with him (Hoden, a morvalt befara, three morvalt dodlig and a morvalt gravmaniska).
Allakhazam lists Basilius at 60-62 in Modernagrav; the island's bestiary lists morvalt andakuva, avliden, befara, dodlig, framkalla, gravmaniska and utforska.
Basilius is a Latin form of the Greek for 'kingly' (to verify); the morvalt titles look Swedish: dodlig deadly, framkalla summon, gravmaniska grave-person (to verify).

story: Basilius is not a morvalt name. He took it, or was given it, by someone who had read old books: it means kingly, and he is the nearest thing the dig on Modernagrav has to a king. He runs the camp that broke through Faraheim's rockwall, he decides who digs and who keeps watch, and he keeps the deadly ones and the grave-workers close. The summoners of his camp are trying to speak with the spirit in the bones. Basilius is not sure he wants it to answer.
legend: Basilius comes with six: Hoden and five morvalt. Mez the casters, kill the gravmaniska, and keep a cure for his bleed. Stun breaks help. Pull him away from the dig or Mortufoghus may wander through. Hoden hits hardest of his crew.

aggro: Guard the dig! Nobody touches the Mother!
death: Let her... sleep... a little longer...
slay: Bury that one with the others.

lairEntry: A morvalt camp around a dig. Spades and bones.
atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Basilius of the dig is slain.

briefing: basilius has 6 adds, mez the casters
aftermathLoss: six adds was too many for one group
